subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the pinned, locked PR-limit announcement stay open now that CONTRIBUTING.md and Barnacle/labeler automation document and enforce the 20-PR cap?
rationale: The source policy is implemented and shipped, but Takhoffman reopened and pinned this issue as a communications artifact, so automation cannot infer when to retire it.

options.title: Keep the pinned notice
options.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the active contributor-facing announcement while the 20-PR cap remains in force.

options.title: Retire the notice
options.body: Unpin and close this issue if maintainers want CONTRIBUTING.md and automation labels to be the only active policy surface.

recommendation.title: Keep the pinned notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the active contributor-facing announcement while the 20-PR cap remains in force.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the 20-cap title change, committed the docs alignment, and reopened/pinned the notice.
